title: Using AI in Student Creative Art Translations and STEM Workshop
summary: RHGE reports that girls in Nigerian community schools created AI-assisted art and advocacy projects. The activities expand creative practice; learning effects are not quantified.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: RHGE reports that girls in Nigerian community schools created AI-assisted art and advocacy projects. The activities expand creative practice; learning effects are not quantified. Active community-school workshops. The chapter reports the stated benefit but does not independently verify it.
purpose: Expand girls' creative and STEM participation through AI-assisted activities.
system: RHGE generative-AI creative-art and STEM workshops
location: Kubwa, Dei Dei, Dutse, and Byazhin, Abuja FCT, Nigeria

ratings.reason: The source reports that girls created AI-assisted digital artworks, narratives, and advocacy projects. This supports a creative-capability gain, without establishing long-term learning or employment effects.
RHGE reports expanding its workshop activities with AI-assisted simulations and creative production. The gain is program capability, not a quantified financial return.

ai_role.statement: Generative AI helps students transform artwork into digital forms, produce narratives, and visualize STEM concepts. Teachers, workshops, and supporting organizations remain central to the activities.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use case -9: Using AI in Student Creative Art Translations and STEM Workshop

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Facilitated school workshops and access to creative AI tools
Teacher and community support for student projects

headline: Girls use generative AI in creative and STEM workshops

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
